title: MV The command plugin I previously used doesn't work when the game file is loaded

posts.author: SpanishPandaHero
posts.body:
Hello!
I'm using RPG Maker MV with a plugin that requires a command plugin to work during messages (it's a plugin to show animated busts of the characters when they're talking).
Each time I save the game in the middle of a conversation, and load that game file again, the command plugin I used on that conversation doesn't work, and because of that, the character's busts are gone until the end of that conversation.
The next time I talk with the NPC it'll work properly.
Is there a way to make a command plugin work again automatically when the game file is loaded?

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body: Could you link to the plugin? There is more than one message bust plugin

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
if the plugin command is used before the message, and during saved,
and load later, this data isn't loaded and failed to work.
if it is saved more dynamic (like Game_System) to reinitilize, it should work.
but like AquaEcho said, link the plugin you need help with to get further assistants.
